_what: The subjects Clovis Community College's 2026-2027 catalog lists in its table of contents under COURSE DESCRIPTIONS (PDF page 3), each with its code, its former code where the catalog names one, and its catalog page. Filed by hand from Sam's reading of the PDF, pasted in session S715 on 2026-11-23, because the session's network could not reach the college's site. `heading` is saved in Title Case with `heading_printed` and the whole `label` as the contents prints them. Rule index: a subject the contents lists. The former codes the contents names (ANTHRO, POLSCI, PSY, SOC, COTR) and ECE's former title are in the college's code history, kb/reference/subject_code_history/clovis_community.json.
